PyTorch 2.13.0 Release Notes Highlights Backwards Incompatible Changes Deprecations New Features Improvements Bug fixes Performance Documentation Developers Highlights FlexAttention lands on Apple Silicon (MPS), with up to ~12x speedup over SDPA on sparse patterns, and gains a deterministic backward path on CUDA for reproducible gradient computation. CuTeDSL "Native DSL" backend gives Inductor a second high-performance code path (alongside Triton) for key GPU operations, with faster compilation.

CuTeDSL "Native DSL" backend gives Inductor a second high-performance code path (alongside Triton) for key GPU operations, with faster compilation.
